fields.source_list_description: The CMA data resource represents a domain-specific data mart focused on payment message processing, validation, and reconciliation. It includes real-time and archived data of inbound and outbound transactions, their statuses, amounts, accounts, and corresponding message directions. The view aggregates results from current (CMA_PAYMENT, CMA_MESSAGES) and archived (CMA_PAYMENT_ARC_IN, CMA_MESSAGES_ARC_IN) sources and links them to contract data and payer/payee metadata to support reconciliation and compliance validation workflows.

fields.query_body: SELECT DISTINCT A.*, IC.PROD, IC.BRN, IC.FIRST_FIRST_CALC_DATE FIRST_CALC_DT, ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY A.CUST_AC_NO, A.BRANCH_CODE, IC.PROD ORDER BY IC.FIRST_FIRST_CALC_DATE) RN FROM STAGE.STG_STTM_CUST_ACCOUNT A, STAGE.STG_ICTB_ACC_PR_HISTORY IC, CORE.REF_DWH_PRODUCT_MAPPING M WHERE 1 = 1 AND IC.ACC = A.CUST_AC_NO AND IC.PROD_TYPE = 'I' AND IC.HAS_ACCR = 'Y' AND A.BRANCH_CODE = IC.BRN AND M.PRODUCT_CODE = IC.PROD AND M.DWH_PRODUCT_TYPE IN ('TD', 'RD')) SELECT L.CUST_AC_NO AS DEAL_NUMBER, L.BRN AS BRANCH_CODE, L.PROD AS PRODUCT_CODE, DECODE(L.ACCOUNT_TYPE, 'Y', 'TD', 'RD') AS MODULE_CODE, L.ALT_AC_NO AS USER_REF_NO, L.C

SELECT L.CUST_AC_NO AS DEAL_NUMBER, L.BRN AS BRANCH_CODE, L.PROD AS PRODUCT_CODE, DECODE(L.ACCOUNT_TYPE, 'Y', 'TD', 'RD') AS MODULE_CODE, L.ALT_AC_NO AS USER_REF_NO, L.CUST_NO AS CUSTOMER_ID, L.CCY AS CURRENCY, (SELECT UNIQUE FIRST_VALUE(B.BAL) OVER(ORDER BY B.VAL_DT) FROM STAGE.STG_ACTB_VD_BAL B WHERE B.ACC = L.CUST_AC_NO AND B.BRN = L.BRANCH_CODE AND B.VAL_DT <= IA.INT_START_DATE) AS AMOUNT, (SELECT UNIQUE FIRST_VALUE(B.LCY_BAL) OVER(ORDER BY B.VAL_DT) FROM STAGE.STG_ACTB_VD_BAL B WHERE B.ACC = L.CUST_AC_NO AND B.BRN = L.BRANCH_CODE AND B.VAL_DT <= IA.INT_START_DATE) AS LCY_AMOUNT, IA.INT_START_DATE AS BOOKING_DATE, IA.MATURITY_DATE, L.ACC_STATUS AS USER_DEFINED_STATUS, L.FIRST_CALC_DT, DECODE(L.RECORD_STAT, 'O', 'A', 'C', 'L') AS CONTRACT_STATUS, NULL AS INTEREST_RATE, 360 AS INTEREST_BASE, NULL AS BASE_INDEX_RATE, L.CR_GL AS DSBR_ACC, 1 AS VERSION_NO, IPI.ACCR_FREQ, IA.INT_START_DATE AS ORIG_BOOK_DATE FROM SQL_ACC L INNER JOIN STAGE.STG_ICTM_ACC IA ON IA.BRN = L.BRN AND IA.ACC = L.CUST_AC_NO AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN STAGE.STG_ICTM_PR_INT IPI ON L.PROD = IPI.PRODUCT_CODE UNION ALL SELECT L.CONTRACT_REF_NO AS DEAL_NUMBER, L.BRANCH AS BRANCH_CODE, L.PRODUCT AS PRODUCT_CODE, L.MODULE AS MODULE_CODE, L.USER_REF_NO, L.COUNTERPARTY AS CUSTOMER_ID, L.CURRENCY, L.AMOUNT, L.AMOUNT AS LCY_AMOUNT, L.BOOKING_DATE, L.MATURITY_DATE, L.USER_DEFINED_STATUS, NULL AS FIRST_CALC_DT, L.CONTRACT_STATUS, L.MAIN_COMP_RATE AS INTEREST_RATE, 365 AS INTEREST_BASE, L.BASE_INDEX_RATE, (SELECT MAX(H.AC_NO) FROM STAGE.STG_LDTB_CONTRACT_MASTER M JOIN CORE.FCT_TRANSACTION H ON H.TRN_REF_NO = M.CONTRACT_REF_NO AND H.AMOUNT_TAG = 'PRINCIPAL' AND H.DRCR_IND = 'C' AND H.TYPE = 6 AND H.EVENT = 'INIT' AND H.TRN_CODE != '!!!' AND H.CUST_GL = 'G' AND H.MODULE = M.MODULE AND H.TRN_DT BETWEEN M.BOOKING_DATE AND M.BOOKING_DATE + 1

(SELECT DISTINCT A.*, IC.PROD, IC.BRN, IC.FIRST_CALC_DT, 1 RN FROM STAGE.STG_STTM_CUST_ACCOUNT A, STAGE.STG_ICTB_ACC_PR IC, CORE.REF_DWH_PRODUCT_MAPPING M WHERE 1 = 1 AND IC.ACC = A.CUST_AC_NO AND IC.PROD_TYPE = 'I' AND IC.HAS_ACCR = 'Y' AND A.BRANCH_CODE = IC.BRN AND M.PRODUCT_CODE = IC.PROD AND M.DWH_PRODUCT_TYPE IN ('TD', 'RD') UNION SELECT DISTINCT A.*, IC.PROD, IC.BRN, IC.FIRST_FIRST_CALC_DATE FIRST_CALC_DT, ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY A.CUST_AC_NO, A.BRANCH_CODE, IC.PROD ORDER BY IC.FIRST_FIRST_CALC_DATE) RN FROM STAGE.STG_STTM_CUST_ACCOUNT A, STAGE.STG_ICTB_ACC_PR_HISTORY IC, CORE.REF_DWH_PRODUCT_MAPPING M WHERE 1 = 1 AND IC.ACC = A.CUST_AC_NO AND IC.PROD_TYPE = 'I' AND IC.HAS_ACCR = 'Y' AND A.BRANCH_CODE = IC.BRN AND M.PRODUCT_CODE = IC.PROD AND M.DWH_PRODUCT_TYPE IN ('TD', 'RD')

fields.query_body: SELECT DISTINCT ed.BRANCH_CODE "BR", a.module_code "MD", ed.ACCOUNT_NUMBER "RN", NULL "MT", ed.event_code "EV", ed.MAKER_ID "ID" from CLTB_ACCOUNT_EVENTS_DIARY ed,cltb_account_master a WHERE ed.account_number = a.account_number AND ed.branch_code = a.branch_code AND ed.AUTH_STATUS='U' AND ed.EVENT_SEQ_NO IS NOT NULL UNION ALL select BRANCH_CODE BR,'WB' MD,TIL_ID RN,NULL MT,'Opened Till' EV,USER_ID ID from FBTB_TILL_MASTER WHERE USER_ID IS NOT NULL and NVL(GLOBAL.X9$,'@#$%')='UBJJOR' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DUAL WHERE NVL(cspkss_os_param.get_param_val('SHOW_TILL_PENDING'),'N') ='Y') UNION ALL Select substr(a.contract_ref_no,1,3) br, a.module md, a.contract_ref_no rn, '' mt, '' ev, a.maker_id id from cstbs_contract_event_log a where a.contract_status <> 'H' and module ='BR' and a.auth_status='U' UNION ALL Select substr(a.REFERENCE_NO,1,3) br, a.module md, A.DCN rn, '' mt, 'Unauthorized Message' ev, a.maker_id id from MSTB_DLY_MSG_OUT a where a.auth_stat='U' and a.suppress_flag <> 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT substr(b.dcn,1,3) br, a.module md, b.DCN rn, '' mt, 'Unauthorized PDE Queue Msg' ev, b.maker_id id FROM mstbs_dly_msg_out a, mstbs_msg_pde_log b WHERE a.dcn = b.dcn AND a.running_no = b.running_no AND b.auth_status = 'U' UNION ALL SELECT P.BRANCH_CODE , 'PDC' , P.TRN_REF_NO , NULL , 'Unauthorized' , P.MAKER_ID FROM DETB_PDC_MASTER P WHERE P.AUTH_STAT = 'U' ;
